Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — MarketLytics is excited to get listed across AWS, Azure, and GCP marketplaces. Before we start the listing paperwork, procurement has a few questions about how Redwood prefers to receive PO/ billing info for marketplace sellers.

Short questions:
- Do we need to submit a vendor intake form before Redwood issues a PO?
- For marketplace billing (AWS SaaS + Azure Marketplace), is Redwood able to accept consolidated invoices or do you require per-cloud invoices?
- Who do we send the signed W-9 / tax documents to?

Attached: initial seller intake (filled) and a short scope of expected usage. Can you point us to the right procurement contact and the PO template Redwood uses? We want to map internal timelines with our finance team.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

Best,
Aisha Kumar
Head of Partnerships
MarketLytics Inc.

Hi Aisha — great to hear and thanks for the intake form. Looping in Marcus (Finance/Procurement) and Kimberly (Marketplace ops) so we can cover the billing/PO details end-to-end.

Quick answers:
- Yes, please complete the vendor intake (you already submitted — thank you). We need the signed intake + W-9 (or local tax equivalent) before we issue a Redwood PO.
- We can accept consolidated invoices in most cases, but for marketplace-specific payout flows (AWS Marketplace SaaS), you may need to submit marketplace receipts to the cloud provider as well. Kimberly will confirm the exact split per marketplace.
- Send tax & banking documents to procurement@redwood.com. For AWS listings, we also ask for the marketplace vendor ID (provided after listing registration).

Marcus — can you attach the latest PO template and note any SOC/compliance artifacts you need up front? Aisha/Tom — if you can confirm DUNS, W-9, and bank remit, we can draft the PO and target activation in ~2 weeks.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Partner_Onboarding_Guide.pdf (application/pdf)]

Hi team — adding a few procurement specifics and timeline.

What we need from MarketLytics to generate a Redwood PO:
- Completed vendor intake (received)
- W-9 (US entities) or W-8BEN (non-US) — signed PDF
- Legal company name exactly as it appears on tax docs
- DUNS number or government-issued company identifier
- Bank remit instructions (ACH preferred) + remittance email
- PO billing contact and invoice email address

PO & billing notes:
- We issue POs on a monthly or quarterly cadence depending on committed spend; for marketplace sellers we typically issue a single Redwood PO that covers the seller's contract with us — marketplaces will still pass-through their own receipts to the cloud provider.
- If MarketLytics requires per-cloud invoices for accounting reconciliation we can generate separate billing lines; this may delay activation by 2–3 business days while we confirm mapping.

I've attached the Redwood PO template and a sample vendor remit form. Please return the W-9 + remit details and we will send a draft PO within 48 hours of receipt.

Next steps for MarketLytics:
1) Upload signed W-9 and bank remit to the Drive link Vanessa shared OR send to procurement@redwood.com.
2) Confirm whether you need consolidated or per-cloud invoices.
3) Provide expected monthly committed spend so we can size the PO correctly.

Attachments: PO_Template_Redwood.docx, Vendor_Remittance_Form.xlsx

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Manager, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
